concepts.summary: 用多项式描述利润、需求、施工与设计，并研究函数、方程和图像。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 连接次数与端行为、除法与余数、因式与零点、重数与图像。

en.title: Chapter purpose
en.summary: Use polynomials to model profit, demand, construction and design, and study their functions, equations and graphs.

method.title: Method
method.body: Connect degree to end behaviour, division to remainders, factors to zeros, and multiplicity to graphs.

concepts.title: 七个核心术语
concepts.summary: 多项式函数；端行为；合成除法；余式定理；因式定理；整数零点定理；零点的重数。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 多项式的幂为非负整数；端行为描述两端趋势；合成除法是系数算法。余式为P(a)；P(a)=0等价于x−a是因式。整数零点须整除常数项；重数是对应因式的指数。

en.title: Seven key terms
en.summary: Polynomial function; end behaviour; synthetic division; remainder theorem; factor theorem; integral zero theorem; multiplicity of a zero.

method.title: Method
method.body: Polynomial powers are nonnegative integers. End behaviour describes both tails. Synthetic division is a coefficient algorithm. The remainder is P(a), and P(a)=0 iff x−a is a factor. An integer zero divides the constant term. Multiplicity is the exponent of its factor.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先计算x−1，再逐项代入，最后和计算器的平方根比较。

method.title: Method
method.body: Calculate x−1, substitute term by term, then compare with the calculator square root.

en.label: Chapter opening · Taylor polynomial
en.prompt: Using $\sqrt{x}\approx1+\frac12(x-1)-\frac18(x-1)^2+\frac1{16}(x-1)^3$, try calculating $\sqrt{1.2}$. How close is your answer to the one the square root key on a calculator gives you?

steps.title: Compare the error
steps.body: $\sqrt{1.2}\approx1.095445115$. The approximation is high by about $0.000054885$, a relative error of about $0.00501\%$.
